reference.issue672_ownership: P6-C1 read-only; CI/template modifications owned exclusively by P6-X/C3 single writer

real_CI_positive.note: Validates actual unmodified HEAD, not simulated future edits. Full repository CI has other failing Native lanes and cannot be globally called PASS.

on_push.jobs: Jobs without PR-only condition; no general P3 timestep

on_same_repo_PR_title_edited_no_base_cha.note: Eligibility derived from YAML job-level conditions for same-repository PR edited event with no base change, not an actually dispatched edit test.

workflow_trigger.cost_note: Sums of per-job timeout ceilings, NOT actual runtime, pricing, or a forecast; CI jobs may be concurrent.
workflow_trigger.fork_guards: The four Native P1/P2 jobs require pull_request.head.repo.full_name to equal HyungseonSong-plasma/moose-test-repo; no unrestricted fork Native job established.
workflow_trigger.edited_base_change_note: validate/runtime-smoke and two other source guards explicitly allow PR edited events when github.event.changes.base != null.
workflow_trigger.non_main_target_PR: General CI does not trigger for PR #684 targeting Draft #665 head branch, by branch filter.

native_and_science_protection.exact_checkout_source_pin: Most source-critical CI jobs assert checkout against github.event.pull_request.head.sha or github.sha. Native jobs explicitly pin source and build container.
native_and_science_protection.protected_EI_material_in_general_Repo_CI: No general workflow secrets.* interpolation or private EI raw rate upload was found in inspected ci.yml; this is not a proof against all external/reusable workflows.
native_and_science_protection.warn_concern: The three jobs include if: always() and if-no-files-found: warn. A missing upload does not independently fail the upload step; downstream accepted evidence must still be checked.
native_and_science_protection.SCIENCE_HOLD: No full P3/P4 general-ci solver timestep; it would be incorrect to infer science acceptance from a successful static/P2 CI.

active_one_shot.impact: Changing this active workflow file on main can intentionally trigger expensive P3/P4; normal changes to ci.yml or generated general-ci template do not satisfy self-path.

negative_static_mutation.mutation: Replace plasma_native_regression job-level same-repo PR condition with if: true in BOTH generated general template and ci.yml (only in-memory)
negative_static_mutation.assertion_scope: Source-static reproduction of selected hard-coded predicates, NOT a claim every repository test would accept this mutation. It demonstrates blind spots in current workflow_harness.render(general) and workflow_surface_guard.check, as they do not explicitly assert this Native job condition.

branch_protection_readback.conclusion: Do not infer branch is unprotected or protected; required status checks/rulesets outside connector visibility may exist.

risks.evidence: 4 internal Native P1/P2 jobs remain eligible on same-repository PR edited without base change, 405 timeout-min ceiling summed.
risks.recommended: Gate Native P1/P2 and other expensive jobs on edited-no-base-change; preserve synchronize/opened/reopened/base-change exact-HEAD execution. Add negative regression for metadata edits.

risks.evidence: Guard tests require edited filter for validate/runtime-smoke only; generator checks names/branch triggers but does not enforce exact if of all Native jobs.
risks.recommended: Assert all 4 native PR-only same-repo guards and cost-sensitive edited filters in the source harness and workflow surface guard, with copy-of-template in-memory mutation negatives.

risks.evidence: Three evidence-upload steps use if-no-files-found: warn, including two ARCH Native P1/P2 workflows.
risks.recommended: Classify mandatory vs optional on-failure artifacts; mandatory receipts must require if-no-files-found: error or equivalent postcondition, while diagnostics may remain WARN if not required.

risks.evidence: GitHub integration 403 on branch-protection endpoints; rulesets list empty.
risks.recommended: Independently verify main/PR665 required checks and enforcement through authorized admin UI or privileged read; do not claim protection without this.
